correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive side lengths, n>=1, 0<=k<=n and N>=1, each of N k-skeleton points has <=k interior entries; hence an averaged off-grid coordinate requires at least one of Nk available free slots. Conversely assign each off-grid coordinate a slot among N rows of capacity k, choose the free coordinate from its adjacent grid interval, and use endpoint rows elsewhere. This proves M_N={offgrid<=Nk}. The distance is obtained by rounding the cheapest m=max(n-Nk,0) coordinates, giving sums of m smallest grid distances. Choosing each coordinate at a grid-cell midpoint maximizes these distances and gives sorted shortest side lengths in the Hausdorff formula. Saturation, dimension and deep-hole loci follow from coordinate strata. Independent exact half-grid sumsets n<=3,N<=3 agree. No n-dimensional volume claim is made below saturation.
